source: JARVIS supercon_3d + supercon_2d (DFPT electron-phonon coupling), NIST, via jarvis-tools
a2f_original_x_note: The alpha^2F(omega) frequency grid (a2f_original_x) is NOT a fixed set of bins shared across materials -- it varies per material and can include negative frequencies (dynamically unstable / imaginary phonon modes). Consumers must interpolate onto a common grid themselves; values are stored as JSON-encoded lists, not fixed-width columns.
wlog_units_note: omega_log (wlog) is stored by JARVIS in Kelvin, not THz/cm^-1 -- this is the logarithmic-averaged phonon frequency the Allen-Dynes formula consumes directly, distinct from a Debye frequency.
overlap_with_dft_3d_note: Every jarvis_id here is drawn from the same id space as dft_3d (see ingest_jarvis_dft.py / data/raw/jarvis_dft.csv.gz) -- these rows are a strict subset by jarvis_id, so downstream joins can use jarvis_id directly rather than falling back to composition_key.
